info.description: CLI tool for inspecting MCP servers, listing their capabilities, and calling tools or prompts for debugging.

options.name: --profiles
options.description:
Load profile entries from a specific file (overrides defaults).
Repeat to merge multiple profile files; duplicate profile
names across files raise an error.

options.name: --profile
options.description:
Force a specific loaded profile by name.
Supports environment expansion ('env:VAR', '${VAR}').

options.name: --try-all
options.description:
Walk every loaded profile sequentially. Currently only valid
with --login.

options.name: --config
options.description:
Load one or more stdio MCP servers from a JSON config file.

across files raise an error.

options.name: --server

options.description: Connect to an HTTP MCP endpoint (alternative to positional URL).
